text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day.
Many Umamusume were walking around happily holding chocolates.
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for coming so late.
I made some chocolate, and...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?
choice_data_list: I thought you weren't interested in that sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you take such good care of me,
Trainer-san, after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I couldn't decide what to make,
so I'm sorry for taking so long."
choice_data_list: No, I'm really happy. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much, as always,
Trainer."
I received a wrapped package of chocolate from her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... so, about what's inside.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
They're not very much
like Valentine's Day chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Since you're always so busy, Trainer,
I thought some chocolates good for nourishment and vitality would be nice...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I made chocolates using vegetables
that are effective against fatigue.

Opening the package, I found vegetable chips
coated in chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank goodness...
choice_data_list: Were you really that worried about me?
Were you really that worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: On my way here, there was a Valentine's Day special playing on the TV in the dorm lounge.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because what was shown there
was pretty different from what we prepared.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I wonder if something a bit cuter
would have been better...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not particularly well-versed in this sort of thing.
choice_data_list: It's a wonderful chocolate as it is!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

I spent a memorable Valentine's Day
with Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what
your favorite food is, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I went with strawberry daifuku.

Upon opening the package,
there was a snow-like strawberry daifuku,
with a strawberry and sweet bean paste carefully wrapped inside!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, what a relief.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... It's just that my favorite treat happens to be strawberry daifuku.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I thought I might be able to make it taste even better, so...

There are two strawberry daifuku.
Since we have them, I want to enjoy them together.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
No, that's not what I meant...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
If it's okay with you, Trainer.

I invited her over, and the two of us enjoyed strawberry daifuku.
The sweet and sour strawberry paired with the subtly sweet red bean paste is exquisite...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... it's delicious...!

—And so, I spent a heartwarming
Valentine's Day together with Silence Suzuka.
